subject: pattern/world-model-loop/explicit-empty-note
claim: A phase that writes a conditional note file must write an explicit-empty record when the condition is false, or the plan's single-path rule must carve `notes/*.md` out — a stale conditional note is worse than no note. In the world-model loop the execute phase must always write `notes/deviations.md` (an empty 'no deviations' record when none occurred) instead of skipping it, because the current contract lets notes/plan.md:29 ('git diff --stat must show a single path') forbid the write the execute prompt orders (world_model_loop.yaml:75-76), so a no-deviation run leaves the prior run's file in place; alternatively the plan's single-path rule must explicitly exempt the loop's notes.
